blocks.content: To foster cooperative federalism through structured support initiatives and mechanisms with the States on a continuous basis, recognizing that strong States make a strong nation.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Fosters cooperative federalism through structured support initiatives with States, recognizing that strong States make a strong nation.
Develops mechanisms to formulate credible plans at the village level and aggregates them progressively at higher levels of government.
Ensures national security interests are explicitly incorporated into economic strategy and policy formulation.
Focuses specifically on vulnerable sections of society that may be at risk of not benefiting adequately from economic progress.
Functions as an extra-constitutional, non-statutory policy think tank providing key strategic and technical advice to Centre and States.

rows: Allocated funds to states and central ministries
Advisory body only; fund allocation power lies with Finance Ministry
States played a passive role via NDC meetings
Active state participation through the Governing Council
Functions as a policy think tank and knowledge hub

items: NITI Aayog follows a 'Bottom-Up' approach to planning, directly contrasting with the Planning Commission's 'Top-Down' model.
NITI Aayog is a policy advisory body (Think Tank) and does NOT have the power to allocate financial funds to states or ministries.
The Governing Council comprises the Prime Minister, Chief Ministers of all States, and Lt. Governors of Union Territories.
